TITLE: Web Programming
INTRO: Web Programming (EE3035) introduces the design and implementation of modern full-stack web applications. The course covers front-end development with React.js, back-end services, databases, and deployment, and is taught through lectures together with hands-on online hackathons and a final project.
INTRO_ZH: 網路服務程式設計（EE3035）介紹現代全端網頁應用程式的設計與實作。課程涵蓋以 React.js 進行的前端開發、後端服務、資料庫與部署，並透過課堂講授、線上黑客松與期末專題的方式進行實作練習。
CONTENTS: Class Introduction / Introduction to Web Programming
Class in JavaScript + Intro. to React.js
Things You Need to Know about Production
CONTENTS_ZH: 課程介紹 / 網頁程式設計簡介
以 JavaScript 開發網頁應用程式
JavaScript 中的類別 + React.js 入門

TITLE: SoC Verification
INTRO: SoC Verification (EEE5023) introduces formal verification techniques for system-on-chip designs. The course covers Boolean reasoning engines (BDD and SAT), model checking, property directed reachability, and SAT-assisted synthesis, with a strong emphasis on both the theory and hands-on use of modern verification tools.
INTRO_ZH: 系統晶片驗證（EEE5023）介紹系統晶片設計之形式化驗證技術。課程涵蓋布林推理引擎（BDD 與 SAT）、模型檢驗、性質導向可達性分析（PDR）與 SAT 輔助合成，兼重理論與現代驗證工具的實作練習。
CONTENTS: Class Intro / Intro to Design Verification
CONTENTS_ZH: 課程介紹 / 設計驗證簡介
形式化建模與性質規格
以 BDD 為基礎的驗證

TITLE: Data Structure and Programming
INTRO: In this class, you will learn the practical issues and gain the real experiences in implementing various data structures with C++ on Linux workstations.
INTRO_ZH: 本課程將帶領同學在 Linux 工作站上以 C++ 實作各種資料結構，從中學習實務問題並累積真實的程式設計經驗。
CONTENTS: Data Structure in Programming: Why is data structure (implementation) so important?
Programming on Linux Workstations: A peek in the real engineering world
C++ Advanced Features Review: When can/should I use them?
What is a Good Program? A software engineering point of view
Computational Complexity: Time and space tradeoffs
Memory Management: How to gain 30% performance improvement easily
Dynamic Array vs. Linked List: Which one is better?
Tree: How to search data faster than linear time?
Graph and Circuit: From CS to EE Applications
Heap, Set and Map: How to store sorted data?
Cache vs. Hash: Virtual memory in your program
Bit Vector and Matrix: All about numerical operations
Putting What You Learn Together: Implementing an advanced data structure (e.g. BDD)
CONTENTS_ZH: 程式設計中的資料結構：為什麼（實作上的）資料結構如此重要？
在 Linux 工作站上程式設計：一窺真實的工程世界
C++ 進階特性回顧：何時可以使用？
什麼是好的程式？軟體工程的觀點
計算複雜度：時間與空間的取捨
記憶體管理：如何輕鬆獲得 30% 的效能提升
動態陣列 vs. 鏈結串列：哪個比較好？
樹：如何比線性時間更快地搜尋資料？
圖與電路：從 CS 到 EE 的應用
Heap、Set 與 Map：如何儲存排序資料？
Cache vs. Hash：程式中的虛擬記憶體
位元向量與矩陣：數值運算的一切
整合所學：實作進階資料結構（如 BDD）
